proposed.evidence: A temporary observation offset is identified between indices 634 and 670. The trajectory shows an abrupt shift across all three components (N, E, U) starting at index 634. Specifically, the N component jumps from near 2 to ~5 MADs, while the E and U components drop significantly by approximately 15-20 MADs. This shifted state is sustained for multiple days until index 670, where an opposing return occurs simultaneously across all axes, bringing the values back to levels consistent with the pre-event trend (e.g., E returning to ~0). The sharp, multi-day rectangular shape affecting all coordinates distinguishes this from physical motion or isolated spikes.
